chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa, from Ali ibn al-Hakam, from Abu Ayyub al-Khazzaz, from Umar ibn Hanzala, who said:

I heard Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) saying: 'There are five signs before the rising of Al-Qa'im: The Scream, and the Sufyani, and the Sinkings (of the earth), and the killing of the Pure Soul, and the Yamani.'
So I said, 'May I be sacrificed for you, if someone from your Household comes out before these signs, shall we come out with him?' He said: 'No'.
So when it was the next morning, I recited this Verse: 'If We please, We should send down upon them a sign from the heaven so that their necks should stoop to it'.
I said to him, 'Is this the Scream?' He said, 'If that were so, then the necks of the enemies of Allah, Mighty and Majestic, would have stooped in humility.'
ai.seo_question: What are the five signs before the rise of the Mahdi and what is the meaning of the Scream?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) identifies five definitive signs preceding the Mahdi's rise, clarifying a common exegetical point regarding the 'Scream' (Al-Sayhah) by linking it to Quran 26:4. He distinguishes this specific divine phenomenon from general submission, emphasizing that it uniquely forces the necks of Allah's enemies into humility, thereby validating its role as a unique eschatological marker rather than a universal event.
